#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compute the ground truth for CSX-234 Q1."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


TASK_ID = "CSX-234_Q1"
PACKAGE_ID = "CSX-234"


class TextExtractor(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.parts: list[str] = []

    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:
        if data.strip():
            self.parts.append(data.strip())

    def text(self) -> str:
        return " ".join(self.parts)


def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
        return json.load(handle)


def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig", errors="replace")


def html_to_text(markup: str) -> str:
    parser = TextExtractor()
    parser.feed(markup)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", parser.text())


def epoch_ms_to_dt(value: int) -> datetime:
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(value / 1000, tz=timezone.utc)


def epoch_ms_to_iso(value: int) -> str:
    return epoch_ms_to_dt(value).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def round_float(value: Any, digits: int = 2) -> float:
    return round(float(value), digits)


def first_number(pattern: str, text: str, cast=float) -> Any:
    match = re.search(pattern, text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not match:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Pattern not found: {pattern}")
    return cast(match.group(1).replace(",", ""))


def phrase_present(phrase: str, text: str) -> bool:
    return phrase.lower() in text.lower()


def pass_fail(value: bool) -> str:
    return "pass" if value else "fail"


def main() -> None:
    task_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    repo_root = task_dir.parents[2]
    package_dir = repo_root / "event_packages" / "standard_event_packages" / "packages" / PACKAGE_ID

    source_files = [
        "metadata/event.json",
        "data/event_reports/event_reports_001_Locked_anchor_USGS.html",
        "data/event_reports/event_reports_002_Locked_event_anchor_2015_Gorkha_Nepal_earthquake_sequence.json",
        "data/event_catalogs/event_catalogs_001_USGS_ComCat_earthquake_query.json",
        "data/physical_hazard/physical_hazard_002_GPM_IMERG_V07_event_accumulated_precipitation.json",
        "data/physical_hazard/physical_hazard_003_CHIRPS_daily_event_accumulated_precipitation.json",
        "data/exposure_impact/exposure_impact_002_WorldPop_GP_100m_population_sum.json",
        "data/remote_sensing/remote_sensing_001_Sentinel-1_GRD_VV_pre_post_change.json",
    ]

    event_meta = load_json(package_dir / source_files[0])
    report_text = html_to_text(read_text(package_dir / source_files[1]))
    anchor = load_json(package_dir / source_files[2])
    usgs = load_json(package_dir / source_files[3])
    gpm = load_json(package_dir / source_files[4])
    chirps = load_json(package_dir / source_files[5])
    worldpop = load_json(package_dir / source_files[6])
    sentinel = load_json(package_dir / source_files[7])

    usgs_features = usgs.get("features", [])
    nepal_features = [
        feature
        for feature in usgs_features
        if "Nepal" in feature.get("properties", {}).get("place", "")
    ]
    nepal_m6plus = [
        feature
        for feature in nepal_features
        if float(feature.get("properties", {}).get("mag", 0)) >= 6.0
    ]
    mainshock = max(nepal_features, key=lambda feature: float(feature["properties"].get("mag", 0)))
    later_nepal_m6plus = [
        feature
        for feature in nepal_m6plus
        if feature["properties"]["time"] > mainshock["properties"]["time"]
    ]
    largest_later_m6plus = max(
        later_nepal_m6plus,
        key=lambda feature: float(feature["properties"].get("mag", 0)),
    )
    largest_later_lag_hours = (
        epoch_ms_to_dt(largest_later_m6plus["properties"]["time"])
        - epoch_ms_to_dt(mainshock["properties"]["time"])
    ).total_seconds() / 3600.0

    fatalities = first_number(r"about\s+([0-9,]+)\s+fatalities", report_text, int)
    injuries = first_number(r"([0-9,]+)\s+injuries", report_text, int)
    destroyed_houses = first_number(r"([0-9,]+)\s+houses destroyed", report_text, int)
    damaged_houses = first_number(r"([0-9,]+)\s+houses damaged", report_text, int)
    reported_aftershock_magnitude = first_number(r"largest being an M([0-9.]+)", report_text, float)
    reported_aftershock_lag_days = first_number(r"May 12,\s+([0-9]+)\s+days after", report_text, int)
    low_quality_building_pct = first_number(r"More than\s+([0-9.]+)%\s+of the buildings", report_text, float)
    kathmandu_ems_low = first_number(r"Kathmandu Valley were\s+([0-9]+)-[0-9]+", report_text, int)
    kathmandu_ems_high = first_number(r"Kathmandu Valley were\s+[0-9]+-([0-9]+)", report_text, int)

    report_flags = {
        "no_surface_rupture_reported": phrase_present("there was no surface rupture", report_text),
        "landslides_were_pervasive": phrase_present(
            "landslides were, by far, the most pervasive surface disturbance", report_text
        ),
        "landslides_second_to_structural_collapses": phrase_present(
            "second only to structural collapses", report_text
        ),
        "dammed_river_lake_present": phrase_present("2.7-km-long", report_text)
        and phrase_present("lake formed behind the dammed river", report_text),
        "liquefaction_present": phrase_present("liquefaction", report_text),
        "progressive_slope_failure_present": phrase_present(
            "Some of the landslides did not fail immediately", report_text
        ),
        "fatalities_injuries_mostly_poor_construction": phrase_present(
            "fatalities and injuries were mostly caused by poor construction", report_text
        ),
    }

    mainshock_magnitude = round_float(mainshock["properties"]["mag"], 1)
    mainshock_depth_km = round_float(mainshock["geometry"]["coordinates"][2], 2)
    kathmandu_ems_midpoint = round_float((kathmandu_ems_low + kathmandu_ems_high) / 2, 1)
    later_m6plus_ratio = round_float(len(later_nepal_m6plus) / len(nepal_m6plus), 2)
    destroyed_to_damaged_ratio = round_float(destroyed_houses / damaged_houses, 2)
    destroyed_share = round_float(destroyed_houses / (destroyed_houses + damaged_houses), 2)
    population_sum = round_float(worldpop["population_sum"]["population"], 2)
    people_per_destroyed_house = round_float(population_sum / destroyed_houses, 2)
    secondary_signal_map = {
        "landslides": report_flags["landslides_were_pervasive"],
        "dammed_river_lake": report_flags["dammed_river_lake_present"],
        "liquefaction": report_flags["liquefaction_present"],
        "progressive_slope_failure": report_flags["progressive_slope_failure_present"],
    }
    secondary_signal_count = sum(1 for present in secondary_signal_map.values() if present)
    radar_pre_count = int(sentinel["counts"]["pre_count"])
    radar_post_count = int(sentinel["counts"]["post_count"])
    radar_post_pre_ratio = round_float(radar_post_count / radar_pre_count, 2) if radar_pre_count else None
    radar_pair_available = radar_pre_count > 0 and radar_post_count > 0
    gpm_precip_max_mm = round_float(gpm["stats"]["gpm_event_precip_mm_max"], 2)
    chirps_precip_max_mm = round_float(chirps["stats"]["chirps_event_precip_mm_max"], 2)
    larger_precip_max_mm = round_float(max(gpm_precip_max_mm, chirps_precip_max_mm), 2)
    gpm_to_chirps_mean_ratio = round_float(
        float(gpm["stats"]["gpm_event_precip_mm_mean"])
        / max(float(chirps["stats"]["chirps_event_precip_mm_mean"]), 1e-9),
        2,
    )

    gates = {
        "shallow_shaking": (
            mainshock_magnitude >= 7.5
            and mainshock_depth_km <= 15
            and kathmandu_ems_midpoint >= 6.0
        ),
        "strong_sequence": (
            later_m6plus_ratio >= 0.50
            and reported_aftershock_magnitude >= 7.0
            and reported_aftershock_lag_days <= 20
        ),
        "collapse_exposure": (
            destroyed_to_damaged_ratio >= 1.0
            and destroyed_share >= 0.60
            and low_quality_building_pct >= 95
        ),
        "secondary_ground_failure": (
            secondary_signal_count >= 3
            and report_flags["landslides_second_to_structural_collapses"]
        ),
        "surface_change_not_primary": (
            report_flags["no_surface_rupture_reported"]
            and not radar_pair_available
        ),
        "rainfall_not_primary": larger_precip_max_mm < 50,
    }

    final_label = (
        "collapse_led_shallow_earthquake_sequence"
        if all(gates.values())
        else "not_proven_by_these_gates"
    )

    if not (
        event_meta["package_id"] == PACKAGE_ID
        and anchor["event_name"] == "2015 Gorkha Nepal earthquake sequence"
        and mainshock_magnitude == 7.8
        and mainshock_depth_km == 8.22
        and len(nepal_m6plus) == 4
        and len(later_nepal_m6plus) == 3
        and round_float(reported_aftershock_magnitude, 1) == 7.3
        and reported_aftershock_lag_days == 17
        and destroyed_houses == 500717
        and damaged_houses == 269190
        and fatalities == 9000
        and injuries == 23000
        and low_quality_building_pct >= 98.0
        and secondary_signal_count == 4
        and radar_pre_count == 2
        and radar_post_count == 0
        and not radar_pair_available
        and final_label == "collapse_led_shallow_earthquake_sequence"
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("CSX-234 source facts no longer match the expected proof")

    computed = {
        "schema_version": "1.0",
        "task_id": TASK_ID,
        "event_id": PACKAGE_ID,
        "task_type": "short_answer",
        "evaluation_mode": "hybrid",
        "difficulty_level": "L3",
        "target_family": "formula_derivation_consistency_proof",
        "primary_gt": {
            "answer": final_label,
            "target_family": "numeric_consistency_proof",
            "gate_results": {name: pass_fail(result) for name, result in gates.items()},
            "key_metrics": {
                "mainshock_mw": mainshock_magnitude,
                "depth_km": mainshock_depth_km,
                "ems_midpoint": kathmandu_ems_midpoint,
                "later_m6plus_ratio": later_m6plus_ratio,
                "reported_aftershock_mw": round_float(reported_aftershock_magnitude, 1),
                "reported_aftershock_lag_days": reported_aftershock_lag_days,
                "destroyed_to_damaged_ratio": destroyed_to_damaged_ratio,
                "destroyed_share": destroyed_share,
                "secondary_signal_count": secondary_signal_count,
                "radar_post_pre_ratio": radar_post_pre_ratio,
                "larger_precip_max_mm": larger_precip_max_mm,
                "gpm_chirps_mean_ratio": gpm_to_chirps_mean_ratio,
            },
            "rejected_leads": [
                "landslide_led_primary",
                "surface_change_or_image_led_primary",
                "rainfall_led_primary",
            ],
            "tolerances": {
                "magnitude": 0.1,
                "depth_km": 0.1,
                "ratio": 0.02,
                "precip_mm": 0.1,
            },
        },
        "event": {
            "event_id": PACKAGE_ID,
            "package_id": PACKAGE_ID,
            "event_name": anchor["event_name"],
            "hazard_family": event_meta["hazard_family"],
            "event_date_or_window": "2015-04-25 to 2015-05-12",
            "location": "Kathmandu Valley and central Nepal",
        },
        "decision_rule": {
            "summary": (
                "Compute six gates for shaking, strong-shock sequence, collapse exposure, "
                "secondary ground failure, surface-change nonlead status, and rainfall nonlead status. "
                "The final label is assigned only when all gates pass."
            ),
            "final_label_if_all_gates_pass": "collapse_led_shallow_earthquake_sequence",
            "fallback_label": "not_proven_by_these_gates",
            "gate_thresholds": {
                "shallow_shaking_gate": "M>=7.5, depth<=15 km, EMS midpoint>=6.0",
                "strong_sequence_gate": "later_M6plus_ratio>=0.50, reported aftershock M>=7.0, lag<=20 days",
                "collapse_exposure_gate": "destroyed/damaged>=1.0, destroyed_share>=0.60, low_quality_pct>=95",
                "secondary_ground_failure_gate": "at least 3 signals and landslides ranked second to structural collapse",
                "surface_change_not_primary_gate": "reported no surface rupture and no usable Sentinel-1 pre/post pair establishing an image-led primary explanation",
                "rainfall_not_primary_gate": "larger GPM/CHIRPS precipitation maximum<50 mm",
            },
        },
        "key_values": {
            "shallow_shaking_gate": {
                "mainshock_id": mainshock["id"],
                "mainshock_time_utc": epoch_ms_to_iso(mainshock["properties"]["time"]),
                "mainshock_magnitude": mainshock_magnitude,
                "mainshock_depth_km": mainshock_depth_km,
                "kathmandu_ems98_range": [kathmandu_ems_low, kathmandu_ems_high],
                "kathmandu_ems98_midpoint": kathmandu_ems_midpoint,
                "threshold_result": pass_fail(gates["shallow_shaking"]),
            },
            "strong_sequence_gate": {
                "usgs_nepal_m6plus_count": len(nepal_m6plus),
                "usgs_later_nepal_m6plus_count": len(later_nepal_m6plus),
                "catalog_count_scope": "Package ComCat query count; the report-cited May 12 M7.3 aftershock is recorded separately below.",
                "later_m6plus_ratio": later_m6plus_ratio,
                "largest_later_usgs_m6plus_id": largest_later_m6plus["id"],
                "largest_later_usgs_m6plus_magnitude": round_float(
                    largest_later_m6plus["properties"]["mag"], 1
                ),
                "largest_later_usgs_m6plus_lag_hours": round_float(largest_later_lag_hours, 2),
                "reported_aftershock_magnitude": round_float(reported_aftershock_magnitude, 1),
                "reported_aftershock_lag_days": reported_aftershock_lag_days,
                "reported_aftershock_source": source_files[1],
                "threshold_result": pass_fail(gates["strong_sequence"]),
            },
            "collapse_exposure_gate": {
                "fatalities_about": fatalities,
                "injuries": injuries,
                "houses_destroyed": destroyed_houses,
                "houses_damaged": damaged_houses,
                "destroyed_to_damaged_house_ratio": destroyed_to_damaged_ratio,
                "destroyed_share": destroyed_share,
                "population_sum_2015": population_sum,
                "people_per_destroyed_house": people_per_destroyed_house,
                "low_quality_building_pct": round_float(low_quality_building_pct, 1),
                "fatalities_injuries_mostly_poor_construction": report_flags[
                    "fatalities_injuries_mostly_poor_construction"
                ],
                "threshold_result": pass_fail(gates["collapse_exposure"]),
            },
            "secondary_ground_failure_gate": {
                "secondary_ground_failure_signal_count": secondary_signal_count,
                "signals": secondary_signal_map,
                "landslides_second_to_structural_collapses": report_flags[
                    "landslides_second_to_structural_collapses"
                ],
                "threshold_result": pass_fail(gates["secondary_ground_failure"]),
            },
            "surface_change_not_primary_gate": {
                "radar_pre_count": radar_pre_count,
                "radar_post_count": radar_post_count,
                "radar_post_pre_ratio": radar_post_pre_ratio,
                "radar_pair_available": radar_pair_available,
                "surface_change_inference": "Sentinel-1 has no usable post-event pair here, so it does not prove absence of change; the non-primary gate relies on the report's no-surface-rupture statement and lack of image-led support.",
                "no_surface_rupture_reported": report_flags["no_surface_rupture_reported"],
                "threshold_result": pass_fail(gates["surface_change_not_primary"]),
            },
            "rainfall_not_primary_gate": {
                "gpm_precip_mean_mm": round_float(gpm["stats"]["gpm_event_precip_mm_mean"], 3),
                "gpm_precip_max_mm": gpm_precip_max_mm,
                "chirps_precip_mean_mm": round_float(chirps["stats"]["chirps_event_precip_mm_mean"], 3),
                "chirps_precip_max_mm": chirps_precip_max_mm,
                "larger_precip_max_mm": larger_precip_max_mm,
                "gpm_to_chirps_mean_precip_ratio": gpm_to_chirps_mean_ratio,
                "threshold_result": pass_fail(gates["rainfall_not_primary"]),
            },
            "final_label": final_label,
        },
        "rubric": {
            "total_points": 20,
            "criteria": [
                {
                    "name": "Requested JSON structure",
                    "points": 4,
                    "description": (
                        "Returns all six named gates, per-gate values, pass/fail results, "
                        "final label, rejected leads, and one concise interpretation."
                    ),
                },
                {
                    "name": "Numeric calculations",
                    "points": 5,
                    "description": (
                        "Computes the specified magnitude, depth, EMS midpoint, sequence ratio, "
                        "aftershock lag, housing ratios, exposure ratio, surface ratio, and "
                        "precipitation metrics within tolerance, while distinguishing package-catalog sequence counts from the separately reported May 12 aftershock."
                    ),
                },
                {
                    "name": "Gate logic",
                    "points": 4,
                    "description": (
                        "Applies all gate thresholds correctly and assigns the final label only "
                        "after all six gates pass."
                    ),
                },
                {
                    "name": "Proof reasoning",
                    "points": 3,
                    "description": (
                        "Explains how the values establish collapse-led shallow earthquake "
                        "sequence consistency, keep ground failures secondary, and avoid treating missing Sentinel-1 post scenes as proof of no surface change."
                    ),
                },
                {
                    "name": "Rejected leads",
                    "points": 2,
                    "description": (
                        "Rejects at least two tempting lead interpretations using computed "
                        "gates: landslide-led, image/surface-change-led, or rainfall-led; image-led rejection must be based on no surface rupture plus absent paired image support, not on a claim of observed no-change."
                    ),
                },
                {
                    "name": "Concise label",
                    "points": 1,
                    "description": "Uses a short final mechanism label consistent with the calculations.",
                },
                {
                    "name": "Overclaim control",
                    "points": 1,
                    "description": (
                        "Keeps the answer bounded to the numeric proof and requested computed fields, including the catalog/report sequence distinction and Sentinel-1 availability limit."
                    ),
                },
            ],
        },
        "provenance": {
            "computed_by": "compute_gt.py",
            "source_files": source_files,
            "notes": "Computed from local CSX-234 package files only.",
        },
    }

    output = task_dir / "computed_gt.json"
    output.write_text(json.dumps(computed, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
